{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''crew''' of brigands was active in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Although the [[Stygian Caldera]] was avoided by most, this group figured that it had to have untold riches, and ventured forth only to stumble across the fabled [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Although most of the crew was wiped out upon their discovery, one of their number, a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] named [[Gloyd]], went on to become an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Navy/Legends|Navy]].
